name: d-2-paths
prompt: Implement paths.rs by inserting the code above its test module (patch: SEARCH the two lines `#[cfg(test)]` and `mod tests {` and REPLACE them with your code followed by those same two lines; keep the tests unchanged). Public functions, each with a one-line doc comment: `is_absolute_target(t: &str) -> bool`: true when t starts with '/' or with two backslashes, or t has at least 3 chars with an ASCII letter first, ':' second and '/' or backslash third. `plain_path_str(p: &str) -> String`: use strip_prefix (not slice numbers): if p has the prefix backslash-backslash-?-backslash-U-N-C-backslash return two backslashes plus the rest; else if it has the prefix backslash-backslash-?-backslash return the rest; else p unchanged. `looks_windows(s: &str) -> bool` = !s.starts_with('/'). `starts_with_target(windows: bool, path: &str, target: &str) -> bool`: normalise both with plain_path_str; when windows is true replace backslash by '/' and lowercase both; trim trailing '/' from both (but keep a lone "/"); true when the target is "/" and the path starts with '/', or path == target, or path starts_with(format!("{target}/")). `folder_ok(p: &str) -> bool` = is_absolute_target(p) && !p.split(['/', '\\']).any(|c| c == "..").
check: export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$HOME/Docker/Personal-projects/kreative-kompanion/server/target RUSTFLAGS='-A warnings'; cd machine-stats && cargo test --quiet paths:: && test $(grep -c 'cfg(test)' src/paths.rs) -eq 1

Update its doc comment to `/// pure: true when a computer grant on `target` reaches `folder` (Linux or Windows paths).` Copy every other line unchanged.
